preconditions.description: The integer n is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= 2 * n and 1 <= v <= 2 * n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices numbered from 1 to 2n.
The graph formed by vertices 1..2n and the given edges is a connected acyclic undirected graph (a tree).

postconditions.description: The output is a single integer representing the count modulo 10^9 + 7.
The output equals the number of distinct bijections from the tree nodes to the 2x n grid cells such that every tree edge maps to adjacent grid cells, modulo 10^9 + 7.
